name: Terrarium 50x40x60
label: Medium terrarium
lead: Glass terrarium measuring 50x40x60 cm. Volume: 120.0 liters, vertical format. Handmade in Novi Sad.

description.html: The 50x40x60 cm terrarium is vertical, with about 120 liters and a floor of 2000 cm². The 60 cm height is greater than the length, so it is intended for species that live on branches. It has no 3D background, so the whole 40 cm depth is left for branches and plants.

For a pair of crested geckos these are comfortable dimensions. It suits a young chameleon while it grows, but an adult veiled chameleon needs a taller and airier space. A young green tree python and emerald tree boa use horizontal branches about 45 cm long, set at two heights. Ventilation is important for all these species, so we agree the placement of the mesh vents according to the animal.

For adult chameleons and arboreal snakes our range has taller models, the 60x40x90 and 60x50x90 with a 3D background. If you need more ventilation for a chameleon, state that in your inquiry. The build has a wait of 7 to 14 days. We cover the outside with a film of your choice, which gives arboreal species cover on three sides.
